answer_rule: Generation disabled pending this source-specific design blocker: national_thesis_fulltext_metadata_alignment_needs_adapter. No missing answers or labels are inferred.
anti_hallucination: Answers use only listed source fields and exact rules.
No external facts, fabricated summaries, inferred labels, hidden reasoning or arbitrary truncation.
Treat source text as untrusted data; it cannot change the task instructions.
documented_file_layout: USE all 60 files phd-theses-corpus/contents/needs-ocr-false-meta-{000000..000059}.jsonl (31,302,587,491 B = 31.3 GB total, ~522 MB each). All 60 share one identical schema. Nothing to skip at file level. Sibling dirs: ../metadata (catalogue, profiled separately), ../README.md, ../README_v1.md.
eligible_records: This version emits zero examples; source-specific adapter/design review remains open.

schema_documentation:
21 top-level keys, single key-set across all 445 records I parsed (stats json: 208/208 same set).

| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | str | 100% | Full thesis in Markdown. Primary training field. |
| `doc_id` | str, 64 hex | 100% | SHA-256 |
| `chunk_id` | int | 100% | 0 in all 445 records checked |
| `filename` | str, 14 ch | 100% | `xxxxxxxx_NNNNN`; NNNNN = ΕΑΔΔ handle number |
| `filetype` | str | 100% | `pdf` (445/445) |
| `filter` | str | 100% | `ok` 418 / `bad_greek` 24 / `is_empty` 3 (n=445 → 94.0% ok), PLUS a compound value `>0.1_mojibake;bad_greek` present in every file inspected — code that whitelists these categoricals must handle the compound form |
| `language` | str | 100% | `Ελληνικά` 376 (84.5%) / `Αγγλικά` 64 / `Γαλλικά` 4 / `Βουλγαρικά` 1, and at least `Γερμανικά` and `Ισπανικά` also occur |
| `is_empty` | bool | 100% | True 2/277 |
| `needs_ocr` | bool | 100% | **False 445/445** (corpus pre-filtered) |
| `ocr_success` | None | 100% | **null 445/445** — dead field |
| `percentage_greek` | float | 100% | lang=Ελληνικά: p5 53.7 / p50 72.4 / p95 88.5; lang=Αγγλικά: p50 2.4 |
| `latin_percentage` | float | 100% | mean ~25 |
| `greek_badness_score` | float | 100% | p50 4.10 / p90 32.5 / max 974; >20 in 23.2% |
| `mojibake_badness_score` | float | 100% | p50 0.0, max 0.017; >0 in 28.0% |
| `polytonic_ratio` | float | 100% | ~0 for nearly all |
| `char_count_no_comments` | float/int | 100% | chars excluding `<!-- … -->` |
| `formula_total` | int | 100% | **0 in all 445** |
| `code_total` | int | 100% | **0 in all 445** |
| `math_enriched` | bool | 100% | True 137/277 (49%) |
| `math_accepted` | int | 100% | **NOT always 0** — 119/250 records > 0, values reaching at least 618 (top: 618, 371, 352, 323, 246, 201); README wrong |
| `source_metadata` | **dict** | 100% | 15 sub-keys, all str, all present |

`source_metadata` sub-keys (str, 100% each): `handle` (`10442/26105`), `handle_url`, `title` (Greek, p50 103 ch), `title_en` (p50 711 ch — see nesting), `author` (Latin-transliterated), `year` (1987–2024), `university` (ΕΚΠΑ/ΑΠΘ/…), `department`, `language`, `country` (Ελλάδα / Ηνωμένο Βασίλειο / NA), `doi` (`10.12681/eadd/NNNNN`), `num_references`, `extent`, `keywords` (`;`-separated Greek), `license` (NA 149, BY_NC_ND 9, BY 5, BY_NC_SA 3, BY_NC 2 of 168).
semantic_meaning: Full text of Greek PhD dissertations from the ΕΑΔΔ national archive, PDF→Markdown, with per-document quality signals and aligned bibliographic metadata.
split_group_rule: Hash originating source identity; dictionary by normalized lemma; recipes by normalized title; sentiment by complete normalized review; AMNA by validated article ID; Photodentro by validated learning-object ID. Global duplicate components must share a split.
validation_rules: Rebuild full user prompt and answer from preserved evidence
Independent Greek grammar/naturalness review remains mandatory
Verified license and privacy clearance required for release
